results.pair_summary: Doc A defines formal operational semantics, state transition rules (Commit/Replay), and invariants for the IR layer. Doc B maps these abstract concepts to specific Delta3 Kernel implementation artifacts (e.g., Event -> WAL_Entry, ValidationReport -> Δ0_Report). They share terminology but serve different architectural purposes: logical definition vs. concrete binding.
results.integration_rationale: Separation of concerns is critical for the Delta3 Kernel architecture. Doc A establishes invariant logic independent of implementation details, ensuring deterministic behavior across backends. Doc B provides necessary binding to physical structures (WAL, RefStore) without polluting the abstract specification. Merging would couple formal semantics with concrete runtime artifacts, reducing flexibility for kernel refactoring.
